title: Program 2 — HauntedDoor
header: public static boolean canEnter(int age, boolean withAdult, boolean scared)

prompt.story: The haunted house has a bouncer. Your program reads a visitor's name, age, whether they are with an adult, and whether they are scared, then decides if they may enter.

method.header: public static boolean canEnter(int age, boolean withAdult, boolean scared)
cases: if the visitor is 12 or older OR is with an adult, AND is not scared
otherwise — anyone who is scared gets false, no matter their age
method.note: Think about which test has to win: being scared beats everything else.

prints: the name, then a comma and a space, then the message.
